notes.title: Stay Home, Stay Safe Sale
notes.content:
Through April 19th, Tombeaux has its biggest sale to date - at 75% off -  in hopes that can provide a bit of respite in all of this madness.​

As an educator, outdoor enthusiast, and game designer, I know how hard it has been to be cooped up at home, without the opportunity to enjoy the things we've always taken for granted, like the natural outdoor environment and everyday social interaction. ​I also know that times are really tough for a lot of people right now, regarding the availability of funds. This sale is hoping to mitigate that for you, even just a little bit.

notes.title: Earth Day Sale!
notes.content: ​In honor of Earth Day​ on April 22nd, as well as Arbor Day​ on April 26th and National Parks Week​from April 22nd-26th, Tombeaux will be on sale at 50% off for one week, starting on Friday, April 19th! With Tombeaux's mission of donating all profits back to the environment, this week is the perfect time to grab Tombeaux at a great price while also doing your part to support our precious earth.

notes.title: 100% of Profits Donated to Environment
notes.content: 100% of the profits from Tombeaux will be donated right back to protecting the river which it is based upon. The donation will be made to the [url=https://www.smm.org/scwrs]St. Croix Watershed Research Station[/url], in order to continue to support research on the river and the [url=https://www.smm.org/scwrs/programs/artist]Artist at Pine Needles Program[/url], from which this game was first envisioned.
